5701.title: Server-native resolution corrupts remote Windows preview paths
5701.rootCauseOneLine: The preview RPC resolves remote Windows roots with Linux-native path semantics before the correctly host-targeted read.
5701.proposedFix: Use owning-root path semantics consistently for resolution and containment, with adversarial path coverage.
5701.caveats: RPC fixture reproduction, not a live Windows host or browser check. No autopilot PR because the resolver implements source-root containment, a security boundary excluded by the rule.
